name: 77017 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77017 (Houston) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77017 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77017 (Houston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
